ios.desc:
Copy once. Find it whenever you need it.

ClipBox is a powerful clipboard manager for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that helps you save, search, organize, and reuse copied content faster.

Keep text, links, images, screenshots, files, code snippets, and frequently used content within easy reach. With smart actions, quick search, privacy controls, keyboard access, and iCloud sync, ClipBox turns copy and paste into a more productive workflow.

SMART CLIPBOARD HISTORY

On Mac, ClipBox keeps a searchable history of supported content you copy so you can quickly find and reuse it later.

On iPhone and iPad, save, organize, access, and paste frequently used clips whenever you need them.

Save and manage:
• Text and snippets
• Links and URLs
• Images and screenshots
• Documents and files
• Code snippets
• Frequently reused content

SMART ACTIONS

ClipBox recognizes supported content types and gives you useful actions instantly.

• OTP & Verification Codes
Quickly recognize copied verification codes and reuse them before they expire.

• Phone Numbers
Detect phone numbers and access relevant actions faster.

• Email Addresses
Recognize email addresses and quickly start a new message.

• QR Codes
Detect supported QR codes from saved images or screenshots and access their content.

• Web Links
Preview and open copied URLs directly from your clipboard history.

• Sensitive Content
Identify supported sensitive content and apply privacy controls such as automatic cleanup.

PRIVACY & AUTO-DELETE

Clipboard history can contain information you may not want to keep permanently. ClipBox gives you more control over sensitive clips.

• Automatically delete supported sensitive content after a selected period
• Control how long clipboard items remain in history
• Protect private ClipBox content with Face ID, Touch ID, or device passcode where supported
• Keep important private clips separate from everyday clipboard content

CLIPBOARD KEYBOARD FOR iPHONE & iPAD

Access saved clips while typing without repeatedly switching apps.

Use the ClipBox keyboard to quickly paste frequently used:
• Messages and replies
• Email text
• Addresses
• Links
• Templates
• Saved snippets

MACOS MENU BAR & HOTKEYS

Keep ClipBox close while you work.

Access clipboard history from the Mac menu bar, search previous clips, and use customizable keyboard shortcuts to bring saved content back into your workflow.

SEARCH & ORGANIZE

Find the right clip quickly, even when your clipboard history grows.

Organize you
